coordinateConvention: Source x points right and y points down. Canvas positive angles rotate clockwise. Rects are [x,y,width,height]; pivots are normalized within each rect.
boundsBasis: Measured alpha>=8 bounds plus two pixels on every side. Full atlas bytes and alpha remain unchanged; source rectangles only select individual sprites.
pivotBasis: Chosen visual centre of each cuff attachment plane; source has no rig metadata. Values are exact integration anchors, with approximately +/-3 source pixels of visual placement tolerance.
orientation: First five poses have bottom cuffs and fingers extending up. Relaxed has top cuff and fingers extending down; angleOffsets[5]=PI preserves the engine fingers-up convention.
